feladatok.cim: Email to Heikki about a gap year in Nepal
feladatok.helyzet: You received the following email from your Finnish friend, Heikki:

bekezdesek: I decided to take a gap year and do some charity work before I go to college, partly, because I want to improve my CV, but also to try myself doing something really and instantly useful.

I found Alliance Nepal, a charity organisation, which offers a volunteer and internship experience in Nepal (in an area of my choice) where I could teach English and also have the opportunity to assist in other school activities such as sports and extracurricular projects (also trips, I hope).
It has always been my dream to go to Nepal, which I think is one of the most mysterious places in the world, so I can’t wait to apply but first I’d like to know what you think of this idea.
Imagine ME standing there? Please reply ASAP.

feladatok.teendo: Write an email of 100-120 words to Heikki in which you tell him
iranyito_szempontok: what you think of taking a gap-year,
if you like his choice of place and charity,
whether you have ever taken part/ would like to take part in a similar project,
what practical questions you think he should ask the organisers.
